title: GroundTruthLabelRecord
description: Schema for clinical reference laboratory measurements and contextual anemia risk labels.

laboratory_hb_g_dl.description: Reference laboratory hemoglobin concentration in g/dL.

measurement_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of reference laboratory blood draw.

measurement_method.description: Laboratory instrument or reference standard method (e.g., Sysmex XN-1000, HemoCue 201+, Cyanmethemoglobin reference).

anemia_label.description: Contextual anemia categorization. Note: Thresholds are population/study-specific and not hardcoded universally.

label_source.description: Origin of the ground truth label.

applied_cutoff_g_dl.description: Specific Hb threshold (g/dL) applied by the study protocol for the categorical label, accounting for age/sex/pregnancy/altitude context.
